activity.notes: Idia, mother of Oba Esigie of the Edo Kingdom of Benin (in today's Nigeria), was credited with pivotal political support during struggles over Esigie's rule. The royal court subsequently established the Iyoba (Queen Mother) title and conferred significant political privileges on her. A Benin City educational institution places one conflict, the Idah War, in 1515–1516; circa 1516 is therefore only a tentative representative activity point, NOT an exact accession, term start or end, or claim that Idia herself was Oba/sovereign ruler. The independent Met essay supports her standing but does not date this war precisely.
